Everything important about creating, playing, repeating, and recovering reminders in %1$s.

Every alert — on the lock screen and in the notification — shows clear buttons:
- Done: marks the task complete. For a repeating reminder it clears only this time and keeps future repeats.
- Silence: stops the alarm sound but keeps the reminder on screen, so you can decide later.
- Snooze: reminds you again after a short delay (5 or 10 minutes on the full-screen alert).
- Play / Speak: appears when nothing is playing, so you can hear a voice or text reminder again.
Tip: Done is the only action that completes a task. Silence just quiets the sound.

- Voice first: Tap the Mic to record a quick spoken reminder.
- Audio file: Pick an existing audio file from your device.
- Reminder message: Shown in the app and notifications.
- Voice notes and audio files take priority over spoken typed text.
- Typed reminders are spoken automatically only for text-only reminders when automatic spoken text is enabled.
- Short label: Optional name for easier scanning in lists.
- Schedule: Pick date, time, repeat, follow-up check, and save.

- Add Reminder lets you preview recorded voice and selected audio before saving.
- Reminder details lets you play, stop, and seek through voice notes and audio files.
- Text-only reminders can still be spoken manually from the app or notification.
- Tone-only mode uses the reminder tone instead of spoken playback.
- You can choose a tone-only alert sound in Settings, and %1$s falls back to the default alarm tone if that sound becomes unavailable.

- Today, Upcoming, Missed, and Done tabs group reminders by state.
- Tap a card to open full reminder details.
- Use the copy button to duplicate an existing reminder.
- Card actions include Play reminder, Done, and the three-dot sheet for Edit, Mark done, Stop recurring, or Delete.

- Repeat modes: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, or Custom.
- The selected date and time become the first occurrence.
- Repeats can end forever, by exact date and time, or after a number of occurrences.
- Marking done on a repeating reminder clears only the current occurrence.

- The reminder notification shows three quick buttons: Done, Snooze, and either Silence (while it is playing) or Play/Speak (to hear it again).
- Done marks the reminder complete; Silence only stops the sound and leaves the reminder so you can act later.
- Swiping the notification away also marks the current occurrence done.
- When enabled in Settings, a lock-screen full-screen alert can appear with the same Done, Silence, Snooze, and Play again actions.

- Missed reminders stay in the Missed tab until you review them.\n- On app open, a missed reminder recovery sheet may offer quick playback of the latest missed reminder.\n- Past reminders can be restored, rescheduled, or replayed from their action sheets.

- Auto-play reminder audio starts voice note or audio file playback when a reminder fires.
- Speak typed reminders automatically controls spoken text for text-only reminders only.
- Spoken language sets the voice for spoken reminders: Auto-detect matches the reminder's own language (so a Hindi reminder is read in Hindi), or you can force Device language or English. The chosen language's voice must be installed in your phone's Text-to-speech settings.
- Manual playback still works even if automatic spoken text is off.
- Private playback tries connected hearing aids, Bluetooth, or wired headphones first. If none are connected, it uses the phone earpiece instead of the speaker.
- Loop playback keeps audio repeating until you stop it or the loop timeout is reached.
- Follow-up check asks again until the reminder is marked done.
- Quiet hours can silence reminder playback during selected times.

- Tone-only mode uses a clear alarm tone instead of voice or TTS.
- You can choose a custom tone-only alert sound, or keep the default alarm tone.
- Alert even during DND lets %1$s try to play important reminders while Do Not Disturb is active.
- When Alert even during DND is off, reminders blocked by DND go to Missed instead of playing.
- This setting does not turn your phone's DND mode on or off. Android DND access is required before notification bypass becomes active.
- When enabled, reminders use alarm-priority audio. Some phone routines can still block alarms if the system mode silences alarm audio.
- If the selected sound is missing later, %1$s automatically falls back to the default alarm tone.
- Use tone-only mode if your phone delays, suppresses, or stops spoken playback.
- Settings > Reliability includes the Battery Optimization Guide for phones with aggressive background restrictions.
- Keep notifications, exact alarms, and battery settings enabled for the best reminder reliability.
- Quick Reminder widget opens Add Reminder directly.\n- Upcoming widget shows upcoming reminders and missed reminders.\n- Wear OS support depends on phone notifications and watch sync being enabled.
- Future reminders are rescheduled automatically after restart.\n- Past-due reminders go through the missed reminder flow instead of firing unexpectedly on boot.

- A follow-up check asks "Did you complete …?" a few minutes after a reminder fires.
- By default it keeps repeating until you mark the reminder done. You can set a repeat limit in Settings > Reliability if you want it to stop on its own.
- Done and Snooze end the current follow-up cycle; Quiet Time also stops follow-ups.
- Follow-up checks continue after a device restart until done or the limit is reached.

- Back up reminders in Settings saves all upcoming reminders, including voice recordings, to a single file you choose.
- Import reminders restores them on this or another device.
- Imports skip exact duplicates and expired one-time reminders; recurring reminders continue from their next occurrence.
- Imported reminders are scheduled immediately.
Keep reminders on screen until done

- Turn on Settings > Reliability > Keep reminder on screen until done to pin the reminder notification so it isn't swiped away by accident.
- While it is on, a swipe only silences the sound and leaves the reminder pending — it stays until you tap Done or Snooze.
- Marking Done always works from the notification, the full-screen alert, or the reminder card, and it stops any follow-up re-alerts.
- Pair it with a follow-up check so the reminder also re-alerts on a timer until it is completed.
SpeakAlert now speaks your language — a fully translated app, clearer alarm buttons, and reminders that can stay until you\'re done.
The whole app is available in English, Spanish, Hindi, and Arabic, with right-to-left support. Choose it in Settings > Appearance > Language.
Reminder alerts and notifications now show Done, Silence, and Snooze. Done completes the task; Silence just stops the sound and keeps the reminder.
Spoken reminders are read in their own language automatically — a Hindi reminder is read in Hindi even if the app is in English. Adjust it in Settings > Playback > Spoken language.
Turn on Settings > Reliability > Keep reminder on screen until done so a reminder stays pinned and only clears when you mark it Done or Snooze.
Back up and move your reminders
Save all upcoming reminders — recordings included — to a file and restore them anytime, even on a new phone. Find it in Settings.
Follow-up checks keep re-alerting until you mark the reminder done, just like before. New: set a repeat limit in Settings > Reliability if you want them to stop on their own.

Some phones, especially Xiaomi and POCO models, stop apps from running in the background to save battery. This can prevent reminders from triggering. Allow %1$s to ignore battery optimization for more reliable reminders.
Battery settings are not available on this device.
